en: A black and white photograph showing a quiet village street. To the left, there is a large building with a sloped tiled roof and sign reading 'Gasthof Windischbauer.' In front of the building, several people, including an elderly man, can be seen, and there is a horse-drawn carriage with a man and some children nearby. The street is lined with trees and wooden fences, suggesting a rural or small-town setting. The overall scene is tranquil and captures everyday life.
